subject: Mobile Development
title: Android Sideloading Freedom
description: A 60-second lesson on Android Sideloading Freedom.

hook.text: Android lets you install apps from any website. No store required.

buildup.text: Sideloading uses APK or AAB files downloaded outside Google Play. Users toggle one setting.

discovery.text: Samsung, Amazon, and others run their own app stores on Android devices.

twist.text: Epic Games distributed Fortnite outside Google Play to avoid the 30% commission.

climax.text: Android's openness gives users choice but also more responsibility for security.

punchline.text: Freedom to install means freedom to choose risk.

quiz.question: What did Epic Games do to avoid Google's 30% cut?
